outlines.outline: Treasure seekers at a wall; A protects belonging and the plan's meaning; B needs a useful route before darkness. Copy B's test as ceremony, then recast its failure as new missions.
Ship partners need contact; A protects apparent competence by changing the secret mission; B needs weather for a watch. Copy radio tapping and use the already stated report as song.
Sellers need a price; A copies a tape measure to appear experienced; B actually measured shelf space. New elbow and credential rules conceal the mistaken expertise and yield a price.
A helps B recover furniture; B wants a deposit-safe room. Copy B ducking as etiquette and insist the same etiquette explains dial consequences.
Restaurateur and supplier negotiate service; A mistakes a measuring gesture for placing an order and keeps up by escalating. B supplies capabilities rather than resisting.
Wedding hosts and guest representative arrange places; A copies unnamed entries as invisible attendees and covers the error by increasing hospitality. B offers useful magical capacities.
Picnickers need supplies outside; A copies a sticky-key maneuver as a setting and keeps claiming helpful routing. B wants to get food safely to lunch.
Colleagues missed a meeting; A copies setting a fast clock and covers by celebrating each earlier arrival. B receives the boss's practical question and can avert the meeting.
Host and dragon's companion arrange tea; A copies a calling gesture as greeting and covers error through hospitality. B offers practical safety and napkins; A fears table manners.
Two people pack a room; A copies a cat-call whistle as a furniture command and never admits the mistake. B wants to retrieve the cup; A's priority is avoiding stains and dirty ladders.
